title: Kraken sues crypto derivatives firm PowerTrade over 'misappropriated' funds claim
summary: PowerTrade changed Kraken’s positive balance of around $7 million to a $2 million deficit via a series of unauthorized “corrections” related to trades that had expired or settled months earlier, according to a legal filing.
